snapshot.basis: Historical DB46 release inventory, DB47 execution, and DB48 closure evidence.

hashPolicy.canonicalSource: Exact Git blob bytes for existing files; exact recovered source bytes for the seven additions.
hashPolicy.normalization: Byte-level CRLF to LF only. Preserve BOM, whitespace, lone CR and final newline count.
hashPolicy.checkoutPolicy: Raw match or CRLF-only variant of the pinned canonical source is accepted; other content changes fail.

exclusions.reason: Not part of the documented historical DB48 chain; not recovered by ENG-002A.
